attempts.rationale: Test a simple robust mean over the full pool to assess baseline performance given unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
test a weighted combination with softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over mean, given strong seasonality and unstable ranking.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9991. Series context: trend strength 0.9996 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.033); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.657.
